description: This file defines a React component named ProjectDetailsModal, which displays details of a project such as Project ID, Project Name fetched via an API call, and Updated At date. It includes internal state management, API fetching logic, and rendering of project details within a modal dialog. The code also defines a helper component KeyValueList for displaying key-value pairs in a styled grid.

methods.name: ProjectDetailsModal({ open, onClose, project })
methods.description: Main React component to display project details in a modal. Manages state for project name, loading, and error, fetches data when modal opens or project ID changes, and renders project info along with error or loading indicators.

methods.name: KeyValueList({ items = [] })
methods.description: Helper component to render a styled list of key-value pairs, used within ProjectDetailsModal to display project attributes.
